name: AIR
summary: A wheeled two-armed robot from a Swiss startup, built to work beside factory staff without a safety cage, with CE marking planned for 2027 when the EU Machinery Regulation takes effect. The only arm figure so far comes from an investor: a 2 kg tendon-driven arm that lifts 5 kg. No price, payload or delivery date has been published.

sources.title: Swiss Startup Embodied AI Unveils AIR — Humanoids Daily
